description: This file is a server-side JavaScript application using Express.js to provide a web interface and API for visualizing and testing database connections across multiple database types (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It includes class definitions for database adapters, configuration loading, and API route handlers.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Abstract base class for database adapters, providing interface methods for testing connection, retrieving tables, and fetching data.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter, providing common SQL query execution methods.

classes.name: PostgresAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for PostgreSQL databases, implementing methods to query table names and data.

classes.name: MySQLAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MySQL databases, implementing methods to query table names and data.

classes.name: SQLiteAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for SQLite databases, implementing methods to query table names and data.

classes.name: MongoDBAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for MongoDB databases, implementing methods to list collections and retrieve data.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from .env files for different database types.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connections to configured databases and reports which are available.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler for API requests that operate on specific database adapters.
